description: This file defines types, functions, and logic related to handling execution approval replies, including building commands, parsing responses, and generating reply payloads for approval workflows in a chat or UI context.

methods.name: resolveAllowedDecisions
methods.description: Resolves the list of allowed decisions, defaulting to the result of resolveExecApprovalAllowedDecisions if not provided.

methods.name: buildApprovalCommandFence
methods.description: Builds a fenced code block string from a list of descriptors' commands.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalCommandText
methods.description: Constructs the approval command string with approval ID and decision.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalActionDescriptors
methods.description: Generates a list of action descriptors for each allowed decision, including labels, styles, and commands.

methods.name: buildApprovalInteractiveButtons
methods.description: Creates interactive buttons for each allowed decision based on descriptors.

methods.name: buildApprovalInteractiveReply
methods.description: Builds an interactive reply object with decision buttons for approval.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalInteractiveReply
methods.description: Wrapper to build an approval interactive reply with specific command ID.

methods.name: getExecApprovalApproverDmNoticeText
methods.description: Returns a static message indicating approval DMs have been sent.

methods.name: parseExecApprovalCommandText
methods.description: Parses a raw approval command string into approval ID and decision.

methods.name: formatExecApprovalExpiresIn
methods.description: Formats the remaining time until expiration into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getExecApprovalReplyMetadata
methods.description: Extracts approval metadata from a reply payload.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalPendingReplyPayload
methods.description: Constructs a reply payload indicating a pending approval with details and interactive options.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalUnavailableReplyPayload
methods.description: Constructs a reply payload indicating approval is unavailable, with reasons and instructions.
